subject: ThoughtBridge — post-demo burn targets, pricing bands, & incentive options
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Eliza Tran <eliza@thoughtbridge.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: ThoughtBridge — post-demo burn targets, pricing bands, & incentive options

Hi Eliza — great demo earlier, thanks for taking the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

Summary of what we heard
- You expect a phased rollout across internal search and a customer-facing chat assistant; initial pilot: ~10M tokens/month, production target: 35–50M tokens/month within 4–6 months.
- Key constraints: predictable unit cost for forecasting, and a preference for committed pricing if it gives a material discount.

Questions we still have
1) Can you confirm the expected monthly peak vs average (10M pilot vs 50M peak)?
2) What internal budget range are you tracking against for Q3 (high/low)?
3) Are you open to a 12–24 month committed agreement if there are multi-year incentives?

Attached: a first-pass SOW template and a simple usage projection sheet — these are placeholders so we can model economics.

Quick proposal items for discussion (we'll follow up with exact numbers after you confirm volumes):
- Unit target: we usually show a target reference point and then tiered volume discounts (example: $900–$1200 / 1M tokens for small pilots, stepping down at defined committed bands).
- Starter credit / startup program: qualifying early-stage teams often get a modest founder credit to accelerate the pilot.
- Multi-year sweeteners: additional rebate or reserved slot priority for 24-month commitments.

Next steps
- Can you send the internal budget band and an ops contact for procurement?
- If you're comfortable, we'd like to propose two priced paths: (A) 12-month committed plan with modest rebate, (B) 24-month committed plan with deeper incentives + reserved capacity.

If helpful, Marcus can draft the two example scenarios this week; Lauren will coordinate contracts and procurement gating items.

Thanks again — happy to hop on a 30-min follow-up next week to walk through the scenarios.

—
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0183
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ThoughtBridge-SOW-draft.pdf (application/pdf), thoughtbridge-usage-projection.xlsx (spreadsheet/xlsx)

From: Eliza Tran <eliza@thoughtbridge.ai>

Cc: Sahil Mehta <sahil@thoughtbridge.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ThoughtBridge — post-demo burn targets, pricing bands, & incentive options

Hi Stephanie — thanks for the detailed recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Pilot: yes, plan is ~8–12M tokens/month for the first 2 months to validate user flows.
- Production ramp: we expect to hit 30M tokens/month by month 5 and a 50–60M/month peak by month 9 if usage holds.
- Budget: procurement gave us a soft cap of $25k–$40k/month for initial production (this is flexible if committed pricing materially improves unit cost).

Sahil is our procurement lead and will handle contract/PO terms — adding him here.

A couple asks: can you confirm an example $/1M token at both the pilot and production bands (even approximate) so we can validate against our financial model? Also, what typical minimum commit bands do you require for the deeper discounts?

Eliza
Co-founder & Head of Product
ThoughtBridge
eliza@thoughtbridge.ai | +1 (415) 987-2210

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Eliza Tran <eliza@thoughtbridge.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ThoughtBridge — post-demo burn targets, pricing bands, & incentive options

Eliza — quick economic sketches so you have numbers to plug into your model. These are illustrative and assume standard model family + moderate quantization. We'll refine once we know model selection and sequence-length profile.

Illustrative unit economics (per 1M tokens):
- Pilot band (0–15M/mo): $1,050 / 1M tokens (no-commit starter rate)
- Committed 12-month band (15–40M/mo): $780 / 1M tokens (5% additional rebate at annual spend thresholds)
- Committed 24-month band (40M+/mo): $620 / 1M tokens (reserved capacity + 10% rebate tied to multi-year commit)

Commit minimum guidance:
- To hit the 12-month band pricing we typically ask for a 6–12 month minimum committed spend sizing (e.g., 20M/mo nominal committed during the term).
- For the 24-month sweetener we expect a higher nominal commit (e.g., 40M/mo or equivalent annualized commitment).

Other levers you can use to change effective $/1M:
- Batching and prefix/KV caching (saves tokens/compute for search-heavy workloads)
- Model quantization profile (we can recommend a Q4_8 or Q5 profile for your latency tolerance)
- Reserved slot priority for predictable peak windows (helps avoid premium burst costs)

I've attached a quick workbook that maps token bands to estimated monthly spend and annualized commit for your 6/12/24-month scenarios. See tab "scenarios" in thoughtbridge-usage-projection.xlsx.

Happy to run a short sensitivity session with your finance lead if helpful.

—
Marcus Lin
Director, Solutions Engineering
marcus@redwood.ai

Eliza / Sahil — looping back with concrete next steps and a recommended path based on the volumes you shared. Thanks for confirming pilot and ramp.

Recommended commercial path (playbook):
1) Pilot (0–12 weeks): no-commit starter rate at $1,050 / 1M tokens; we provide a $10k founder credit if you join our startup program (qualifies ThoughtBridge).
2) Production commit (months 3–12): migrate to a 12-month commitment targeting ~25M/mo; modeled rate: $780 / 1M tokens. We can structure a backstop that lets you step up capacity with pre-agreed breakpoints.
3) Multi-year incentive (optional): a 24-month reserved plan targeting 40M/mo that adds reserved slot priority and increases rebate to effectively $620 / 1M tokens, plus a year-2 credit applied as a dollar rebate against consumption.

We can present two priced scenarios for procurement this week (12-month vs 24-month). If you'd like, Lauren will prepare a compact checklist of procurement asks (PO template, security attestation pointers, billing contact) and a redline-friendly SOW.

Action items
- Sahil: can you confirm the procurement contact and desired billing cadence (monthly vs quarterly)?
- Eliza: please confirm whether you want us to model a 30%/70% or 50%/50% dev/prod split so we can size the committed band appropriately.
- We'll send a DocuSign with the 12-month priced scenario + standard SOW for review (link included).
